docket_entries.description: DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE OF CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FILED BY PLAINTIFF GONZALEZ, RAMON AS TO DEFENDANT ALFARO, FRANCISCO CLAIM HEARING OF SEP-16-2019 OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL FILED
FILE DESTROYED PER ORDER SIGNED BY JUDGE SAMUEL FENG ON 10/11/2022 PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 681.53.
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,600.00 FILED BY GONZALEZ, RAMON AS TO DEFENDANT ALFARO, FRANCISCO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-01-2019 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
ORDER RE: CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-01-2019 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO SEP-16-2019 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF RAMON GONZALES IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT FRANCISCO ALFARO IS NOT PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE FILED. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT PRIOR TO HEARING. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE SEP-16-2019 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCE AT THE SEP-16-2019 HEARING THIS CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHAEL MAU; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
